MT-24                    MANUAL TRANSMISSION — W58 Transmission

11. INSTALL BEARING RETAINER
(a) Using snap ring pliers, install the bearing snap ring.
NOTE: Be sure the snap ring is flush with the intermediate plate surface.
(b) Using a torx socket wrench, tighten the screws.
Torque: 130 kg-cm (9 ft-lb, 13 N-m)

12. INSTALL REVERSE GEAR
Using SST, install the reverse gear.
SST 09312-20011

13. INSTALL SNAP RING
Select a snap ring that will allow minimum axial play and install it on the shaft.
